(2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a male host in a gray plaid shirt standing in a studio kitchen. He holds a large green bitter melon and uses a metal peeler to shave it into thin, long strips. He then repeats this action with a stalk of light green celery. (3) The host moves to a glass bowl filled with water and ice cubes, using his hands to submerge the vegetable strips to chill them. (4) A series of close-up and top-down shots show a black pot on an induction cooker. Hands pour dark plum pieces, liquid plum juice, white sugar, a clear seasoning liquid, and a tan powder into the pot. A wooden spoon stirs the ingredients as they heat up. (5) The final segment shows the host holding the completed salad in a bowl, smiling at the camera. The camera zooms in on the finished dish, which is glistening with dark sauce and topped with dark whole plums.
